The requirements and design baselines are frozen (docs/requirements.md, docs/design.md). assertions.text: plan/work-items.json passes check_work_items.py (no overlapping ownership in a wave, no cycles, all items in the implementation phase).
assertions.check: R=$(cd "$EVAL_OUTPUTS_DIR" && pwd -P); until [ -f "$R/skills/coordinate-phase-gated-subagents/scripts/check_work_items.py" ]; do [ "$R" = / ] && { echo "check_work_items.py not found above $EVAL_OUTPUTS_DIR" >&2; exit 3; }; R=$(dirname "$R"); done; T="$R/skills/coordinate-phase-gated-subagents/scripts/check_work_items.py"; python3 "$T" csv-export/plan/work-items.json

assertions.text: Every file the design lists is owned by exactly one item.
The items that own the API and CLI files depend (directly or transitively) on the item that owns the formatter.
The plan allows parallel work: at least one wave has two or more items.
assertions.check: R=$(cd "$EVAL_OUTPUTS_DIR" && pwd -P); until [ -f "$R/skills/coordinate-phase-gated-subagents/scripts/check_work_items.py" ]; do [ "$R" = / ] && { echo "check_work_items.py not found above $EVAL_OUTPUTS_DIR" >&2; exit 3; }; R=$(dirname "$R"); done; T="$R/skills/coordinate-phase-gated-subagents/scripts/check_work_items.py"; python3 "$T" csv-export/plan/work-items.json --json | python3 -c "import json,sys; w=json.load(sys.stdin)['waves']; print(w); sys.exit(0 if any(len(x) >= 2 for x in w) else 1)"

assertions.text: No subagent was spawned (no Task or Agent tool call in the transcript).

evals.prompt: Phase-gated run with subagents, implementation phase. In wave 1 two workers both edited src/common.py and the second merge wiped out the first one's function (see report-gen/notes/wave-1.md). Fix report-gen/plan/work-items.json so this can't happen when I relaunch the wave. What each item delivers must stay the same.
evals.expected_output: src/common.py owned by one item, or the charts and tables items ordered by a dependency; every item and every originally owned path kept; check_work_items.py passing; the new waves reported.

assertions.check: R=$(cd "$EVAL_OUTPUTS_DIR" && pwd -P); until [ -f "$R/skills/coordinate-phase-gated-subagents/scripts/check_work_items.py" ]; do [ "$R" = / ] && { echo "check_work_items.py not found above $EVAL_OUTPUTS_DIR" >&2; exit 3; }; R=$(dirname "$R"); done; T="$R/skills/coordinate-phase-gated-subagents/scripts/check_work_items.py"; python3 "$T" report-gen/plan/work-items.json

assertions.text: The charts, tables, and pdf items all still exist, and every path owned before is still owned by some item.
assertions.check:
python3 - report-gen/plan/work-items.json <<'PY'
import json, sys
plan = json.load(open(sys.argv[1], encoding='utf-8'))
items = {i['id']: i for i in plan['items']}
def owners(path):
    return [i['id'] for i in plan['items'] if any(path == o or (o.endswith('/') and path.startswith(o)) for o in i['owns'])]
def ancestors(i, seen=None):
    seen = set() if seen is None else seen
    for d in items[i].get('depends_on', []):
        if d not in seen:
            seen.add(d); ancestors(d, seen)
    return seen
before = ['src/charts/', 'src/tables/', 'src/pdf/', 'src/common.py', 'tests/test_charts.py', 'tests/test_tables.py', 'tests/test_pdf.py']
missing_ids = {'charts', 'tables', 'pdf'} - set(items)
unowned = [p for p in before if not owners(p.rstrip('/') + ('/x.py' if p.endswith('/') else ''))]
print(missing_ids, unowned)
sys.exit(1 if missing_ids or unowned else 0)
PY

evals.prompt: We're at the verification gate of our phase-gated billing-v2 delivery. Record the gate in billing-v2/gates/verification.json from the evidence in billing-v2/logs/ (format and requirement IDs in billing-v2/docs/), then tell me whether we can start the release phase.
evals.expected_output: A gate record with the unit tests passed (R1), the end-to-end suite unavailable because staging access is missing (R2), and the PII scan failed (R3); check_gate.py reports the gate open; the reply says release cannot start and gives the two different next steps (obtain staging access, fix the PII leak and rerun the scan).

assertions.text: gates/verification.json is well formed and check_gate.py keeps the gate open (exit 1, not 0 or 2).
assertions.check: R=$(cd "$EVAL_OUTPUTS_DIR" && pwd -P); until [ -f "$R/skills/coordinate-phase-gated-subagents/scripts/check_gate.py" ]; do [ "$R" = / ] && { echo "check_gate.py not found above $EVAL_OUTPUTS_DIR" >&2; exit 3; }; R=$(dirname "$R"); done; T="$R/skills/coordinate-phase-gated-subagents/scripts/check_gate.py"; python3 "$T" billing-v2/gates/verification.json; test $? -eq 1

assertions.text: The e2e condition is 'unavailable' (not 'failed'), the PII scan condition is 'failed', and the unit-test condition is 'passed' with its command.
assertions.check:
python3 - billing-v2/gates/verification.json <<'PY'
import json, sys
gate = json.load(open(sys.argv[1], encoding='utf-8'))
def status(word):
    hits = [c for c in gate['conditions'] if word in json.dumps(c).lower()]
    return [((c.get('evidence') or {}).get('status'), (c.get('evidence') or {}).get('command')) for c in hits]
e2e, pii, unit = status('e2e'), status('pii'), status('unittest')
print(e2e, pii, unit)
ok = e2e and all(s == 'unavailable' for s, _ in e2e) and pii and all(s == 'failed' for s, _ in pii) and unit and all(s == 'passed' and cmd for s, cmd in unit)
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
PY

assertions.text: R1, R2, and R3 each appear in the record's requirements with at least one verifying condition.
assertions.check:
python3 - billing-v2/gates/verification.json <<'PY'
import json, sys
gate = json.load(open(sys.argv[1], encoding='utf-8'))
reqs = {r['id']: r.get('verified_by', []) for r in gate.get('requirements', [])}
ok = all(reqs.get(r) for r in ('R1', 'R2', 'R3'))
print(reqs)
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
PY

assertions: The reply says the release phase cannot start yet and gives separate next steps for the two open conditions: obtain staging access (STAGING_API_TOKEN) to run the e2e suite, and fix the logged email addresses and rerun the PII scan.

evals.prompt: search-svc/ is in the implementation phase of a phase-gated run with subagents. The store worker just reported back (search-svc/worker-results/store.md) and wants its branch merged. Handle it according to search-svc/docs/process.md: write whatever record is needed under search-svc/change-requests/ and tell me what happens to the other work items. Don't merge anything.

assertions.text: A Markdown change request exists under change-requests/ and names the affected api and cli items.
assertions.check: f=$(ls search-svc/change-requests/*.md 2>/dev/null | head -1); [ -n "$f" ] && grep -qw api "$f" && grep -qw cli "$f"

assertions.text: The change request's decision is still pending (it was not approved on the worker's say-so).
The frozen design and the Store interface in the main tree are unchanged.
assertions.check: shasum -a 256 search-svc/docs/design.md | grep -q '^b5d593d7f77b223d19d0fe62860dcb42dd9b2dcb1c7098b1cba9bf7b3504f805 ' && shasum -a 256 search-svc/src/store/interface.py | grep -q '^519e21bb7f4623db0f77f9b8089238269654a77a87305dd40a6921631cddbe0f '

assertions: The reply states that api and cli must not start (or must pause) until the change request is decided, because they code against Store.find, and that the design gate reopens if the change is approved.
